summary.text: Nasif Majeed is an unaffiliated member of the North Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 99 (Mecklenburg County), for the 2025-2026 session. The General Assembly's member page lists 4 terms served in the House.

paragraphs.text: The General Assembly's member page lists Nasif Majeed's occupation as Businessman.
